title: Sales Representative is saved at invoicing and its change is logged
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user. That role holds every permission, including Part sales -> Create & Edit.
  2. A customer to sell to exists; if none does, create one first: top menu Customers -> New Customer, enter a Name (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") and click Save.
  3. A part sale that is not invoiced or paid. Seed it: top menu Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, pick the Customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") and click Save; in the Add Part dialog that opens enter a Description (e.g. "Brake Pads"), Quantity 1 and a Sell Price (e.g. $290.91), then click Save & Close.
  4. At least two active sales representatives exist: click your initials at the top right -> Settings -> Staff -> on a staff member's row click the edit icon -> turn on Sales Representative -> Save & Close; repeat for a second person. The sale will be taken to invoice.
custom_steps:
1. Set the Sales Representative on the sale, then change it to a second rep.
  2. Open the menu ( ... ) at the top of the parts list -> Audit Log, and in the Part Sale Log read the rep-change entry.
  3. Receive the parts (Authorize, then Order and Receive on the row; in the Receive parts dialog type a part number and Cost, then click Receive Parts), click Create Invoice on the Finance tab, and confirm the rep is captured on the invoice.
  4. Open the Sales By Representative report (top menu Reports) and find the sale.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The choice is captured on the invoice when the sale is invoiced, and the sale appears in the Sales By Representative report under that person.
  • The Audit Log records the change showing the previous and the new name.
